newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wong's Circuits public offer subscribed 10.5 times.
newsitem.headline: Wong's Circuits public offer subscribed 10.5 times.

text.p: The initial public offer (IPO) of Wong's Circuits Holdings Ltd closed on Tuesday with the public tranche of 8.07 million shares 10.5 times subscribed, a company statement said.

The Hong Kong-based company had offered a total of 43 million shares shares at US$0.88 each for its IPO. Of the total, 34.4 million were successfully placed with institutional investors at the launch of the offer.
The listing has raised US$24 million for the company.
Wong's Circuits makes printed circuit boards for customers in various industries including computers, telecommunications and consumer electronics.
